name: Perfect Weapon
description:
The connection of your spirit to your weapon has been perfected. You gain the following benefits while wielding your Ghaal’Shaarat.Perfect Mighty Blade. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with the weapon, unless it already had this bonus or a better one. Additionally, the first time you attack with your Ghaal’Shaarat on your turn, you can transfer some or all of the weapon’s bonus to your Armor Class. The bonus remains until the start of your next turn.

Elemental Strike. When you hit a creature with an attack roll using your Ghaal’Shaarat, choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. Your Ghaal’Shaarat deals an extra 1d6 damage of the chosen type; and you can cause the weapon to deal the chosen type of damage or its normal damage type.

Soul Bound. You have Resistance to Psychic damage, and you have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions.
